profiles.name: LiquidAI d1-2B (CPU E-cores, llama.cpp)
profiles.description: Zero-VRAM co-resident /v1/systemone decision model pinned to CPU E-cores (12-15). Never evicts the resident GPU LLM; verified live on text triage (~1.8s on 4 E-cores).

profiles.name: vLLM-SR d3-27B Artemis (Q3_K_S, llama.cpp)
